paras: The Kabinda worm lizard (Monopeltis kabindae) is a species of amphisbaenian in the family Amphisbaenidae. The species is native to Central Africa.
M. kabindae is found in the Central African Republic and the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
The type locality is Kabinda, Democratic Republic of the Congo.
The holotype of M. kabindae has a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 188 mm (7.4 in).
The mode of reproduction of M. kabindae is unknown.
